title: FREE Ways To Boost Etsy Sales Online (FULL COURSE)
key_points: Dylan Jarris has 13 years e-commerce experience, worked at Zappos and Zulily managing hundred million dollar portfolios, made over $1 million profit on Etsy, built company of 53 team members, taught over 6,000 Etsy sellers, founded software company called Etsy SEO

Customer-centric SEO focuses on how customers search (problem, purpose, utility, recipient, occasion) rather than how sellers describe products (specific details, nuances) — example: 'dog mom necklace gift for dog lover' versus '14 karat oblong link gold necklace'
High-intent keyword framework has four formulas: 1) gift for recipient under price point, 2) occasion outfit for person, 3) theme plus item for event, 4) item idea for location
Buyer SEO adds event, occasion, recipient, emotion, location, or use case — example: 'funny 30th birthday shirt for brother' versus browser SEO like 'funny shirt'
Backlinking and PR tools include Quoted and HARO/HERO which email daily opportunities to pitch products for inclusion in gift guides and articles with links back to product pages

Email marketing grew from 5,000 to over 100,000 subscribers; tools include Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Flodesk; over 70% of people shop on mobile so links preferred over QR codes; Gary Vee's 'jab jab jab right hook' and Hormozi's 'give give give until they ask' approach

Facebook groups strategy: Dylan's video editor got over 100 orders within 24 hours from one post; post screenshots showing shop name without links; example groups include golden retriever owner group with 150,000 people and interior design groups; post two similar products asking 'I'm torn between these two, help'

Pinterest uses 7x7 strategy: pin 7 pins per day from your site, 7 days a week, using Google Chrome extension with Pinterest business account; brought over half a million free visits to Dylan's shop; results typically seen 6 weeks to 6 months; one person got 1.1 million monthly views after consistent year of Pinterest

Instagram automation through ManyChat: caption instructs viewer to comment a word, ManyChat DMs them links, photos, messages, voice memos; can set up nurture sequences with delays (2 hours, 1 day, 4 days, 1 month later); Dylan considers ManyChat more effective than email marketing currently

YouTube shorts can be up to 3 minutes long; Dylan has over 130,000 YouTube subscribers; editing tools include CapCut and GetMunch; content ideas: making products, assembling, packaging, stacking orders, organizing inventory, creating designs, outsourcing, markets; one short got over 1 million views; community section allows up to 3 mobile notifications per day

Etsy funnel: Etsy fees are 6.5% plus 3% credit card processing plus 20 cent listing fee; traffic typically appears within 3-4 weeks with optimized listings; cannot tell Etsy customers to buy on website (fee avoidance) but can use social media as bridge; Dylan made over $100,000 from website within first 12 years without ads by funneling Etsy traffic to Shopify

Blogging tools include Blogger/Blogspot, WordPress, Substack; easy content is lists like '10 gift ideas for X'; Emily from The Sweetest Thing cited as example blogger linking products with coupon codes and affiliate links

Influencer partnerships focus on micro-influencers with 10,000-50,000 followers who often promote in exchange for free product without payment; Dylan has worked with influencers from 10K followers up to Shawn Johnson and Bachelor/Bachelorette contestants
Social commerce includes TikTok shop, Instagram shop, Facebook shop; strategy is first transaction on social platform then funnel to website for future transactions

Giveaway strategy runs 7-14 days; collaborate with 5-10 micro-influencers or complementary businesses (not competitors); rules should be limited to 1-2 requirements like following and commenting; requires daily 'hype person' engagement with countdowns and FOMO; $5/day ads optional; track followers, engagement, daily lift, use UTMs and codes per partner
Recommended approach: choose 2-3 methods from the 12, not all; free 16-step checklist available for Etsy funnel; Dylan has podcast called 'Etsy Seller Success with Dylan Jarvis'
summary:
Dylan Jarris presents 12 free traffic methods for e-commerce businesses in 2026, drawing from 13 years experience including roles at Zappos and Zulily managing hundred million dollar portfolios, making over $1 million profit on Etsy, building a 53-person company, teaching 6,000+ Etsy sellers, and founding Etsy SEO software. The presentation targets sellers with low traffic, non-converting traffic, those avoiding ads, or seeking year-over-year growth, with the recommendation to implement 2-3 methods rather than all 12.

Method 1 is customer-centric SEO as a foundation, focusing on how customers search (problem, purpose, utility, recipient, occasion) versus seller descriptions. Four high-intent keyword formulas are provided: gift for recipient under price point, occasion outfit for person, theme plus item for event, and item idea for location. Method 2 covers backlinking and PR using tools like Quoted and HARO/HERO which email daily pitch opportunities for gift guides. Method 3 addresses email marketing where Dylan grew from 5,000 to 100,000+ subscribers using Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or Flodesk, emphasizing value-giving content over promotions.

Method 4 highlights Facebook groups as the fastest-working free traffic source, with Dylan's video editor getting 100+ orders in 24 hours from one post. The strategy involves posting product screenshots (not links) in interest groups like a 150,000-member golden retriever group, asking for opinions between two products. Method 5 covers Pinterest using the 7x7 strategy (7 pins daily, 7 days weekly) via Google Chrome extension, which brought over 500,000 free visits to Dylan's shop, with results typically appearing 6 weeks to 6 months out. Method 6 explains Instagram automation through ManyChat for comment-triggered DM sequences with delays that Dylan considers more effective than current email marketing.

Method 7 addresses YouTube shorts (up to 3 minutes) with content like packaging orders and behind-the-scenes footage, using CapCut or GetMunch for editing; Dylan has 130,000+ subscribers and one short reached 1 million views. Method 8 details the Etsy funnel strategy where fees total approximately 9.5% plus 20 cents per listing, traffic appears within 3-4 weeks, and social media serves as a bridge to websites since direct redirection constitutes fee avoidance — this approach generated $100,000+ for Dylan's website without ads. Method 9 covers blogging using Blogger, WordPress, or Substack with list-format posts linking products.

Method 10 recommends influencer partnerships with micro-influencers (10,000-50,000 followers) who often accept free product without payment, noting Dylan's experience ranges from micro-influencers to Shawn Johnson and Bachelor contestants. Method 11 covers social commerce on TikTok shop, Instagram shop, and Facebook shop where first transactions occur on-platform before funneling to websites. Method 12 outlines giveaway strategy running 7-14 days with 5-10 collaborating micro-influencers or complementary businesses, limiting entry requirements to 1-2 actions, requiring daily engagement to create FOMO, with optional $5/day ads and UTM tracking per partner.
